learning_outcomes.text: Explains the basic concepts of ergonomics and the principles of ergonomic design.
Evaluates human performance and anthropometric characteristics from an ergonomic perspective.
Evaluates the effects of environmental factors on working conditions and productivity.
Analyzes ergonomic applications and evaluates their suitability.

syllabus_topics: Explanation of the concept of ergonomics and lesson plan
Explanation of the ergonomically design term and its effects to human.
What is the Human for ergonomic science? What is the energy requirement for human? What is the limit continuous performance? Fatigue and break, and mental activities.
Environmental factors and the effects of working life and productivity. Noise and vibration, the effects on employees, it's reduction techniques and constructive measures.
Explanations of the ergonomically workplace design.
Lifting and torque applications in workplace.
The ergonomic design of work tools and equipment.
Ergonomic product design, applications and evaluations.
Anthropometric measurements. Compliance control of ergonomic.
